Lemma
[No nontrivial steady breathers on closed manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0399 ↗ lem:chow-ii-appd-lambda-monotonicity 1. appD:D.30\group Perelman Invariants

If a closed Ricci flow satisfies $\lambda (g(t_1))=\lambda (g(t_2))$ for $t_1<t_2$, then it is Ricci-flat. Thus every steady Ricci breather on a closed manifold is Ricci-flat.
